title: Melting in Your Ears Tonight. — Ear-Licking × Cuddling with My 27-Year-Old Girlfriend — [English Subtitled Edition]

images.alt: Melting in Your Ears Tonight. — Ear-Licking × Cuddling with My 27-Year-Old Girlfriend — [English Subtitled Edition] [夜咄堂]

body.intro:
**[English Subtitled Edition]**

A whole night, melting at your ears — ear-licking and cuddling with your 27-year-old girlfriend.

She warmed up the bed and is waiting for you. Tonight she'll clean your ears, massage away the day's fatigue, whisper pillow talk, and fill both of your ears with her breath and kisses... until you drift off to sleep in her arms.

This edition includes the full original Japanese audio with **complete English subtitles**:

- **MP4 (1280×720)** — subtitled video over the jacket artwork, so you can follow every whispered line
- **MP3 (128 kbps)** — the original audio tracks (same master as the Japanese release, encoded at 128 kbps)
- **SRT** — subtitle files for use with your own player

8 tracks / approx. 54 minutes. Binaural-style left/right ear panning — headphones strongly recommended.

**Track list**
01 Introduction (4:52) / 02 Ear Cleaning and Massage (10:22) / 03 Whispered Pillow Talk (10:18) / 04 Ear Licking (Left and Right) (6:19) / 05 Ear Licking and Whispers (5:38) / 06 Sweet Cuddles (6:04) / 07 Closer Still... (6:07) / 08 Drifting Off to Sleep (4:42)

*The voices in this work are AI-generated using the COEIROINK speech synthesis software (credited below). The English subtitles were translated by AI and reviewed and edited by the author. All characters are adults (the heroine is 27 years old).*

Voice credit: COEIROINK:アンジーさん

****

27歳の彼女と過ごす一晩を描いた、耳舐め×添い寝シチュエーションボイスの英語字幕版です。

お布団を温めて待っていた彼女が、耳かき、マッサージ、添い寝トークであなたを甘やかし、両耳の吐息とキスで満たして、最後は腕の中で眠りへ誘います。

本編は日本語版(RJ01771248)と同一の日本語音声に、全編英語字幕を付けたエディションです。

- **MP4(1280×720)**:ジャケット画像に英語字幕を焼き込んだ動画。囁きの一行一行を追えます
- **MP3(128kbps)**:日本語版と同一マスターのオリジナル音声を128kbpsでエンコード。純粋に聴く用
- **SRT**:英語字幕ファイル単体。お好みのプレイヤーでも使えます

全8トラック/合計約54分。左右の耳への定位あり。ヘッドホン推奨。
